entries.label: Hospital — salle de soins
entries.scene: The Hospital ward interior from Portable Ops. Use only the indoor frames in the contact sheets: blue-grey painted plaster walls, thin metal-framed beds with pale white/green mattresses and simple squared headboards, freestanding pale green vertically pleated privacy screens, small light-grey cabinets, dark recessed plain doorways, large worn ochre-brown square floor tiles, a dark hospital reception counter visible on one side. Dim greenish institutional lighting and simple 1970 room fixtures. Leave clear foreground floor with the beds and screens against the background. This is the actual medical ward, not the Research Lab and not the Cyprus hospital of TPP; no modern monitors or machinery absent from the screenshots.
